title: Output Schema for PGP Decrypt Operation
description: Output schema for the cryptography pgpDecrypt operation.

payload.description: The recovered plaintext: text (outputType=TEXT) or base64 of the bytes (outputType=BINARY). Present in the response variable when overwriteBody is false; when overwriteBody is true the plaintext is written to the message body instead (raw application/octet-stream for outputType=BINARY).

attributes.description: Metadata about the pgpDecrypt operation, including any file name and modification time embedded in the OpenPGP literal-data packet.

fileName.description: The original file name embedded in the message, when present (absent for the default _CONSOLE sentinel).

modificationTime.description: The modification time embedded in the message as an ISO-8601 instant, when present.

headers.description: Transport headers associated with the response.
